sentences.en: This day was just a waste of time and money.
sentences.zh: 这一天纯粹就是浪费时间和金钱。

sentences.en: The river is polluted by waste from houses and factories.
sentences.zh: 这条河被房屋和工厂排放的废物污染了。

sentences.en: It seems a waste of time to wait any longer.
sentences.zh: 再等下去似乎就是在浪费时间。
